Cybersecurity Analyst salary in Illinois

Based on 8 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for Cybersecurity Analyst jobs in Illinois is $104,140–$119,283 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $112,720 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.
